content:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-p99 detector triggered for `us-west-2` streaming cluster (p99 > 1.2s, baseline 0.18s). Paging oncall. Rule: realtime/streaming/p99_high

alex: Oncall here, joining. Any automated mitigations kicked? :eyes:

mira: I see the same in dashboards — spike started ~22:12 UTC, correlates with KV cache miss rate jump. `kv_hit_rate` dropped from 98% to ~62%

samir: Logs show repeated `EVICT` messages and single-tenant client from cid: 0x9a4f sending huge seqs. Could be noisy client causing eviction storm.

jordan: Customer impact? Which routes hit hardest?

alex: Route `/v1/stream/generate` accounts for 78% of tail latency; small fraction of requests are huge context (~20k tokens) from that client. Latency for embeddings unaffected.

kai: Quick mitigation idea: 1) throttle that client IP (rate-limit) 2) enable prefix prefetch for stream reads 3) temporarily increase KV cache size on the affected pool. Which do we want first?

mira: Prefetch isn't hot-deployable to all nodes quickly. Throttle + cache bump is fastest. I can bump per-pool cache to 1.5x (risk: memory pressure)

samir: I can push a rate-limit rule via edge: `edgectl rate-limit add --cid 0x9a4f --rps 5 --ttl 10m`

alex: Do it. Mira, bump cache and keep an eye on OOMs. Samir, after rule confirm, shift small-model routes off the hot pool as fallback.

ops-bot: `edgectl` change applied by samir at 22:15:42 UTC — rule id rl_3321, target cid 0x9a4f, rps=5, ttl=10m

mira: Increased kv cache size for pool `us-west-2-a` from 48GB to 72GB at 22:16:10 UTC. No OOMs so far.

alex: Observable impact: p99 dropped from ~1.4s -> ~0.35s within 90s of mitigations. Good. Continue monitoring.

jordan: Customer-facing update: small number of requests degraded, most recovered after 22:17. I'll prepare a short note if it persists.

samir: For postmortem: need to consider guarding against single-tenant eviction storms — maybe per-tenant cache caps and backpressure at edge.

mira: Agree. I'll capture graphs (kv_hit_rate, p95/p99 by route, eviction events) and attach to the incident doc.

alex: Triage checklist: 1) Stabilized? yes 2) Root cause hypothesis: tenant-induced eviction storm 3) Immediate action: throttle + cache bump 4) Next steps: followup action items for infra and platform.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity auto-set to sev2. Duration: 00:07 so far. Paging cleared if team marks resolved.

alex: Marking incident as "monitoring". Keep channel open until 22:45 UTC for final checks. :thumbsup:

jordan: I'll draft a short customer note and coordinate with CS if any accounts request details.

samir: Adding mitigations to runbook: `edge rate-limit quick-block` + `pool cache bump` steps.

mira: Saving dashboard snapshots and queries to the incident ticket.

alex: Thanks team. Will update the timeline in the doc and assign postmortem owners. If p99 creeps back up, page immediately.

incident-bot: RESOLUTION: p99 returned to baseline and no new eviction alerts after 22:38 UTC. Incident moved to post-incident review state at 22:39 UTC.
